questions.q: By default, cell references are relative and change when a formula is copied.
The IF function can give different results depending on a condition.
The ____ function finds the smallest value in a range.
A reference such as $A$1 that never changes when copied is called an ____ reference.
Showing only the rows that meet a condition is called ____ the data.
The ____ function counts the cells in a range that contain numbers.
Explain the difference between a relative and an absolute cell reference.
questions.answer: A relative reference changes when the formula is copied to another cell (1); an absolute reference (e.g. $A$1) stays the same when copied (1).

questions.q: Write a formula that shows 'Pass' in C2 if the mark in B2 is 50 or more, otherwise 'Fail'.
questions.answer: =IF(B2>=50,"Pass","Fail") - 1 mark for IF with the test B2>=50, 1 mark for both results in quotation marks.

questions.q: Give two things that make a chart easy to read.
questions.answer: Any two from: a clear title; labelled axes; a key/legend; a suitable chart type; a sensible scale.
